ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Oneclick Logistics India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Record Date — Oneclick Logistics India Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Bonus  is 15-Oct-2026.

Bonus — Oneclick Logistics India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on September 04, 2026, have inter-alia considered and approved bonus at the ratio of 1 : 2, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Oneclick Logistics India Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Resignation — Oneclick Logistics India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Aditya Vikrambhai Patel as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. August 18, 2026.

Resignation — Oneclick Logistics India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Ashish Nayak as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. July 25, 2026.
General Updates — Oneclick Logistics India Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 60% Equity Share Capital of Winners Freight Management India Private Limited.
